rows.ARS:
Orange blend Grandiflora.
Registration name: MAClanter
Exhibition name: Octoberfest ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1989).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 1999 as 'Lantern'.
rows.Bloom: Orange blend, yellow reverse, ages to lighter . Moderate, fruity fragrance. 25 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, narrow, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 47" to 6' (120 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
